text:
```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Run security scanner
        id: scan
        run: |
          python scripts/scan_plugin.py
          echo "exit_code=$?" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Handle scan results
        if: steps.scan.outputs.exit_code != '0'
        run: |
          if [ "${{ steps.scan.outputs.exit_code }}" -eq 1 ]; then
            echo "BLOCK findings detected. Failing CI."
            exit 1
          elif [ "${{ steps.scan.outputs.exit_code }}" -eq 2 ]; then
            echo "WARN findings detected. Review required."
            exit 0
          else
            echo "Unexpected exit code ${{ steps.scan.outputs.exit_code }}."
            exit 1
          fi
```
